nodes.label: PI4P
props: (2R)-2,3-bis(alkanoyloxy)propyl (1R,2R,3R,4R,5S,6R)-2,3,5,6-tetrahydroxy-4-(phosphonatooxy)cyclohexyl phosphate; 1-(3-sn-phosphatidyl)-1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate; 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol-4-phosphate; 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol-4-phosphate trianion; a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate); phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate; phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate trianion; phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate(3-)

nodes.label: PI(3,4)P2
props: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained via global deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 3,4-bisphosphate.

nodes.label: INPP5B
props: Regulates phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PtdIns(4,5)P2) cellular levels by cleaving the phosphate at the 5-position producing PtdIns(4)P. Also hydrolyzes the 5-position phosphate from inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate (Ins(1,4,5)P3), thereby modulating cellular signaling events
Cytoplasm, cytosol, Endoplasmic reticulum-Golgi intermediate compartment, Early endosome membrane, Membrane, Cytoplasmic vesicle, phagosome membrane, Golgi apparatus

nodes.label: INPP5F
props: Inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase F; Sac domain-containing inositol phosphatase 2; Sac domain-containing phosphoinositide 4-phosphatase 2

Phosphoinositide phosphatase which catalyzes the hydrolysis of phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate (1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate), PtdIns(4)P). May be functionally linked to OCRL, which converts phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PtdIns(4,5)P2) to PtdIns, for a sequential dephosphorylation of (PtdIns(4,5)P2) at the 5 and 4 position of inositol, thus playing an important role in the endocytic recycling.
Membrane, clathrin-coated pit, Early endosome, Recycling endosome

nodes.label: PTEN
props: Phosphatidylinositol 3,4,5-trisphosphate 3-phosphatase and dual-specificity protein phosphatase PTEN
Inositol polyphosphate 3-phosphatase; Mutated in multiple advanced cancers 1; Phosphatase and tensin homolog

Dual-specificity protein phosphatase, dephosphorylating tyrosine-, serine- and threonine-phosphorylated proteins. Also functions as a lipid phosphatase, removing the phosphate in the D3 position of the inositol ring of PtdIns(3,4,5)P3/phosphatidylinositol 3,4,5-trisphosphate, PtdIns(3,4)P2/phosphatidylinositol 3,4-diphosphate and PtdIns3P/phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate with a preference for PtdIns(3,4,5)P3.
Cytoplasm, Nucleus, Nucleus, PML body, Cell projection, dendritic spine, Postsynaptic density, Secreted

props: EGF stimulates the growth of various epidermal and epithelial tissues in vivo and in vitro and of some fibroblasts in cell culture. nodes.label: GRB2
props: Adapter protein GRB2; Protein Ash; SH2/SH3 adapter GRB2

Non-enzymatic adapter protein that plays a pivotal role in precisely regulated signaling cascades from cell surface receptors to cellular responses, including signaling transduction and gene expression. Thus, participates in many biological processes including regulation of innate and adaptive immunity, autophagy, DNA repair or necroptosis.
